_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the external validation cohort in the fixture (5,000 patients from the same population): the optimism-corrected estimates should equal the model's external performance, so their difference has truth 0

agreement.claim: both engines choose the same penalty and report the same apparent, optimism, corrected and external AUC and slope
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 in every key, including the selected penalty. harness/prediction_examples.test.py checks the fit solves its penalized score equations (1e-8), equals the unpenalized MLE as the penalty vanishes (1e-6), and that the penalty is the argmin of the cross-validated deviance.

recovery.claim: the corrected estimates are close to the external cohort's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Wide by nature: a single development sample of 300 estimates its own optimism imprecisely. The check that the correction works is the mean-bias assertion over the seeds (corrected within half the apparent optimism, for AUC and slope). Measured by harness/prediction_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic (owner decisions E5, E6).
